record.body:
## Rationale

`orchestra view roadmap` is a normal `View` with an area role and an idea role, grouped by `area`. `View` gains one optional setting, a default group name, so ideas with no area land in `untriaged`. The shared renderer keeps `--effort`, record links and layout identical to the other views. Existing views set no default and render as before.

## Counter-argument

A dedicated roadmap renderer needs no change to the shared engine and cannot break the other views. The generic engine groups by a payload field and falls back to the record subject, so a default group is a special case that only the roadmap needs.

payload.choice: Extend the view engine with an optional default group name; roadmap groups ideas by area with untriaged as default

record.subject: roadmap-group-default
